name: Expo mobile app
description: Expo (React Native, TypeScript) with npm, jest-expo, ESLint (eslint-config-expo), and a CI workflow running the same checks.
notes: Init flags were run once for real on 2026-11-22 (create-expo-app@3, TypeScript 6). tsconfig.json is overwritten to add types: ["jest"], because TypeScript 6 no longer loads @types packages by default.

files..github/workflows/ci.yml:
name: ci
on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm run lint
      - run: npm run typecheck
      - run: npm test -- --ci

Run the app locally with `npx expo start`.

## Working rules

- One issue, one small PR: at most 300 changed lines, tests included.
- Every source change adds or changes a test.
- No new dependencies without a human. A change to `package.json` or a lockfile always goes to a human for review.
- Stay inside the MVP scope in `PLAN.md`. Its non-goals are out of scope.
